title: How to Improve Overprint and Varnish Adhesion on Foil

seo.title: How to Improve Overprint and Varnish Adhesion on Foil

content:
Some paper box designs need another print or finish step after foil stamping.

## Main Point

Not every foil surface is suitable for this. If the next layer does not stay well, the design can look uneven or lose durability.

## How to Choose

Use a foil grade designed for post-printing or post-finish work. Test the complete production sequence before approval.

## FAQ

### Can I print over foil?

Yes, if the foil surface and the next process are compatible.

## Sample Support

Share your process sequence. We can recommend suitable foil options.
